coverage.includes: Main Kaggriculture assistant transcript: research plus monitoring, maintenance and closeout; not research-only. Historical token events were backfilled.
coverage.excludes: Other agent/subagent transcripts and separate advisor usage unless present in this main transcript. In-flight/unindexed tail and work outside recorded coverage are not included.

source.description: Read-only own-agent aggregate from the existing local scheduling controller, backed by saved native token/turn events and scheduler records.

assistant_elapsed.definition: Turn elapsed includes pending tools, waits, network latency and other overhead. Neither quantity is measured model/GPU compute time. Do not add the subset again.

scheduler_observed_subset.definition: Allocated core-seconds are reserved cores multiplied by observed running wall time, not sampled CPU busy time. These post-competition records are not total research compute.

gpu.interpretation: No attributed hardware observations in this table; missing coverage, not proof of zero historical GPU use. Final policies and reported simulator batches run on CPU.

money.note: No project-level payment ledger or defensible allocation. API list prices are not subscription charges. Shared-machine electricity estimates are not assigned to this project.

local_experiment_measurements.hardware: CPU simulation; exact CPU SKU and sampled busy-core time were not recorded in these receipts.
local_experiment_measurements.scope: Four completed confirmation batches only; wall time includes batch overhead, excludes scheduler queue wait before execution. No reruns for accounting.
